rule: Only discoveries that can materially change another workstream belong here. Local implementation detail stays in that workstream RETURN/Git history.

deltas.summary: Prometeo now has one stable agent entrypoint, NOW router, scoped task packs, delta propagation and compact returns. Fresh chats should route before repository archaeology.
deltas.action: Start from `.well-known/prometeo.json`; do not reconstruct every historical subsystem before knowing the task.

deltas.summary: Voice/intention capture is being consolidated into `shared/capture/v1` on the P4 candidate branch instead of page-local microphones or an uncontrolled second global shell.
deltas.action: Do not build another page-local Capture stack. If the current task needs voice, read the P4 packet and treat shared/capture/v1 as candidate ownership, not yet Human Accepted/Served authority.

deltas.summary: Shared gestures follow explicit Input Ownership / Focus Lease rules: exactly one subsystem owns an active gesture and temporary focus ownership is lease-based.
deltas.action: When adding touch, pointer, recorder or overlay interaction, reuse the existing ownership grammar instead of stacking global listeners.

deltas.summary: The active life preview encoded stable visual/data invariants: 14 equal history columns ending at HOY, momentum shares the exact day X centers and is derived from logs, compressed free time is one passive full-width band, and one surface has one vertical scroll owner.
deltas.action: Future Calendar/Habits work should preserve `model-contract.json` v2 instead of rediscovering these decisions from screenshots or chat history.

deltas.summary: Prometeo Agent Runtime v2 compiles one current Work Packet per active workstream, includes only relevant cross-chat/branch deltas, defines FAST/DEEP/EXHAUSTIVE/CONTINUE profiles, and adds the visible Prometeo Seal.
deltas.action: Prefer the compiled packet from `/agent-runtime/manifest.json` over manually reconstructing NOW/PACK/RETURN/DELTA. `Prometeo` means resync+recover+continue; `.` means continue the active frontier. Print `🟣 P✓` only after entry+packet were actually loaded.

deltas.summary: Agent Network v3 adds a tiny EPOCH freshness check, independent per-chat worker status, auto-discovered workstreams, derived read-only NETWORK/CONVERGENCE views and filtered cross-chat dependency/impact events in Work Packet v3.
deltas.action: After one-time bootstrap, read EPOCH before material work. Same EPOCH means continue immediately; new EPOCH means reload only the active compiled Work Packet. Do not read all other chats or edit a shared central status file.

deltas.summary: Prometeo private runtime now has one claimed owner, one live Finance profile and one active first-device session. The one-time owner bootstrap is consumed. Mercado Pago is still NOT_CONNECTED and no real financial data or provider credentials belong in GitHub. GitHub Pages serving must be reasoned from gh-pages rather than assuming main is live.
deltas.action: Route Finance/Auth work through the `finance-auth` packet. Never recreate owner/profile to simplify login, never wire Calendar directly to Mercado Pago, and do not enable bulk import/automatic sync before a minimal provider probe plus reconciliation.

deltas.summary: Recent human intent sharpens P4 Capture: the same global Prometeo control should allow microphone capture from any page without leaving or blocking it; recordings support pause/play/save/delete and consecutive takes; transcription is non-blocking; saved notes remain editable and can later be copied/transformed into prompts.
deltas.action: Ingest these UX requirements into the existing P4 Capture owner rather than creating another recorder, toolbar or page-local microphone. Preserve Input Ownership/Focus Lease and navigation authority while implementing them.

deltas.summary: Cross-chat handoff must not make the human copy a large prompt. Before asking the human to switch chats, the source worker publishes material state to its LAST_RETURN and any truly cross-workstream discovery to DELTA_FEED (or a scoped worker status). The destination chat receives only `Prometeo`, detects the new EPOCH and consumes the compiled relevant packet/deltas.
deltas.action: Treat the repository/runtime as the message bus. Do not ask the human to relay a recoverable prompt between Prometeo chats. If a destination chat needs an explicit instruction payload, persist it in the relevant workstream/return first, then tell the human only which chat to open and to send `Prometeo`.

deltas.summary: The max-length Calendar/Habits/Money chat has been recovered into durable workstream state by combining the partial human transcript with Git history and existing contracts. The stale calendar branch was 150 commits behind main with no unique divergence and has been safely fast-forwarded. Current continuation must preserve responsive event geometry, local-first Habits IndexedDB ownership, universal event links v32, dialog stability v33 and the settled Habit negative knowledge without asking for or redesigning the old chat.
deltas.action: Calendar-related agents must load the updated calendar-life-preview packet/RETURN and RECOVERY_2026-09-09 before material edits. Treat shared/storage/v1/HABITS_PERSISTENCE_CONTRACT_V31.json and shared/calendar/v1/EVENT_LINKS_CONTRACT_V32.json as required contracts. Refresh Finance truth through finance-auth and route voice through P4 Capture rather than duplicating either subsystem.

deltas.summary: Finance/Auth browser integration is now software-ready for cross-device verification. The actually served gh-pages bootstrap supports reusable passwordless login for the already-claimed owner with user creation disabled, and an isolated Finance/Auth canary mounts the tested authenticated Finance adapter into the currently served Calendar without promoting production Calendar. A persisted owner session upgrades the Finance boundary to JWT-protected finance-v1; absent/failed private access remains explicitly synthetic. Mercado Pago is still NOT_CONNECTED.
deltas.action: Calendar continues to consume Finance rather than Mercado Pago and P4 remains the Capture owner. Do not merge/promote Finance or begin Mercado Pago provider probing until a second physical device authenticates as the existing owner and confirms the canary reaches private Finance; after that, verify real-browser fallback and only then run the minimal provider probe plus reconciliation.

deltas.summary: P4 Capture is software-ready through an isolated served gh-pages canary. Candidate CI now passes Capture lifecycle/memory/Patent contracts, consecutive recording with retained microphone stream and Focus Lease, exact private export flow from frozen preview through explicit approval receipt to Patent, embedded Navigator Input Ownership/Workflow realm guards, reincarnation and single-owner publication. P4 remains Candidate-only and has not become Human Accepted or Served authority.
deltas.action: Route microphone/voice work to shared/capture/v1 and do not create page-local recorders or restore competing shell injectors. Calendar keeps voice through P4 and Finance through finance-auth. The next P4 gate is physical microphone/audio/navigation evidence plus explicit human export approval if export is desired; do not automate or fabricate those human events.

deltas.summary: R10 recovered historical Universal Input value into the existing P4 owner without reviving a global shell. The P4 candidate host now supports direct LOCAL typed Capture, local audio playback and clipboard copy in addition to microphone/consecutive recording; typed text remains EDITED until explicit confirmation, and Play/Copy do not authorize LOCAL-to-PROJECT export. Candidate CI and the isolated canary are green.
deltas.action: Route both text and voice Capture through shared/capture/v1. Do not add page-local text/microphone stores and do not re-enable V2/V3 global shell injectors. Preserve explicit export-receipt and Human Acceptance boundaries.

deltas.summary: R02 recovered PROMETEO LAB R1-B against live Current/Lineage. Later Prometeo already owns the architecture through Part 2 tested-candidate modules (Context Foundry v2, persistence, durable ledger, workflow/reincarnation and candidate Classes/Student World engines) plus later P3 release/rollback evidence. Recovery therefore preserves routing and invariants instead of creating a second architecture or promoting internal candidates.
deltas.action: Route future changes to the existing scoped owner. Preserve Candidate/Current/Human Accepted/Served separation, Context Foundry privacy/currentness fail-closed rules, staged-CAS versus durable-ledger separation and distinct release/canary/acceptance/serve/rollback/export gates. Do not resurrect historical R1-B package/file-count/checkpoint claims unless exact durable bytes are recovered.
